name: The Traitors Türkiye
overview: Twenty well-known figures set off for the mysterious castle of The Traitors Türkiye. A cryptic game of wits, full of surprises, awaits them. While they work together by day to grow the prize money in their communal vault, betrayal reveals itself by night. As the Traitors 'execute' the Faithful each night, the Faithful attempt to uncover the Traitors at the Round Table.
